You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Excessive consumption of meat is unhealthy. Furthermore, the production of meat is comparably resource-intensive. We should thus all limit our consumption of meat rigorously. One could worry that our farmers would then run into economic difficulties. However, no serious economist has confirmed this prediction to date.
What argument components exists in sentence " Furthermore, the production of meat is comparably resource-intensive" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>Furthermore, the production of meat is comparably resource-intensive</pro>
